leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the jar and lid was a predictable preparation with little decision involved.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary, though the final two choices were the only offered actions.

continue.text: I would probably not continue personally: the preservation sequence was coherent, but the available choices made it quite predictable.
